source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Chapter 1 exercise (PDF 30-32, key PDF 226).

blocks.text: Yeh chapter ki exercise hai, kitab ke order mein. Har short aur long sawal ka jawab us topic ke Roman Urdu lesson mein hai jis se woh talluq rakhta hai (neeche list dekhein).
Q.1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
1. Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) ka sab se bara maqsad kya hai?

items: a) Websites design karna
b) Waqt aur kharche ke andaze ke andar high-quality software dena
c) Database systems sambhalna
d) Hardware components banana

blocks.text: 2. Kaun si requirement batati hai ke system ko kaise perform karna chahiye?

items: a) Functional Requirements
b) Non-Functional Requirements
c) Technical Requirements
d) Operational Requirements

blocks.text: 3. SDLC mein framework ka kya kirdar hai?

items: a) Code bilkul shuru se likhna
b) Pehle se bane components aur architectures ke saath structured bunyad dena
c) Hardware sambhalna
d) Haath se (manual) testing karna

blocks.text: 4. Kaun sa software development model chhote cycles ya sprints mein kaam karta hai?

items: a) Waterfall Model
b) Agile Methodology
c) Lean Software Development
d) Scrum

blocks.text: 5. Scrum mein rukawatein hatane aur Scrum practices aasan banane ki zimmedari kis role ki hai?

items: a) Product Owner
b) Scrum Master
c) Development Team
d) Project Manager

blocks.text: 6. In mein se kaun sa DevOps ka faida nahi?

items: a) Behtar collaboration
b) Behtar quality
c) Project scope creep (daire ka be-qaboo phailao) mein izafa
d) Market tak jaldi pohanch

blocks.text: 7. Comprehensive project planning ka aham pehlu kya hai?

items: a) Project ka scope aur kaam samajhna
b) Project ki colour scheme tay karna
c) Bari development team rakhna
d) Mumkina risks ko nazar andaz karna

blocks.text: 8. Kaun sa factor software project ke kharche ke andaze par asar NAHI dalta?

items: a) Project ka scope
b) Technology stack
c) Hone wali meetings ki tadaad
d) Operational costs

blocks.text: 9. Kharche ke andaze mein contingency fund ka maqsad kya hai?

items: a) Achanak (unexpected) kharche poore karna
b) Marketing ke kharche dena
c) Aur (extra) developers rakhna
d) Naya hardware khareedna

blocks.text: 10. In mein se Use Case Diagrams ka maqsad kaun sa hai?

items: a) System ki architecture likhna
b) System ki functional requirements pehchanna aur likhna
c) Database schema dikhana
d) System ke user interface ka design tay karna
Functional aur non-functional requirements mein farq bataein.
Bataein ke SDLC mein testing phase kyun aham hai, aur is ki ahmiyat ki do wajahein dein.
Agile Methodology mein continuous integration ka concept samjhayein aur software development mein is ki ahmiyat par baat karein.
Scrum framework ke aham hisse pehchanein aur analyze karein (jaanchein) ke har hissa project management mein kaise madad karta hai.
Risk assessment aur management ke main steps ko evaluate karein (jaanchein) aur software project mein un ki ahmiyat bataein.
Software development mein Use Case Diagram ka maqsad samjhayein.
Sequence Diagram aur Activity Diagram ka muqabla karein aur aham farq bataein.
Factory Pattern bayan karein aur misal ke saath bataein ke yeh objects ko seedha banane se kaise mukhtalif hai.
Software application mein user registration ke process ka flowchart banayein. Is ke aham steps likhein.
Farz karein aap ek saada mobile application banane ka project chala rahe hain. Bataein ke aap is project mein Agile Methodology kaise istemal karenge.

Aap aise project par kaam kar rahe hain jis mein bohat zyada documentation chahiye aur bohat khaas regulatory (qanooni) requirements hain. Bataein ke Scrum methodology is project ke liye shayad munasib kyun nahi, aur koi doosri methodology suggest karein.
Online banking system lein. Use Case Diagram banayein jo customers, bank staff aur system ke darmiyan interactions dikhaye.
Aap food delivery application bana rahe hain. Sequence Diagram banayein jo order dene ka process dikhaye: customer ke items chunne se le kar order ki delivery tak.
Software development process mein software development tools ki ahmiyat par baat karein.
a) Software banane aur sambhalne mein language editors, translators aur debuggers ka kirdar samjhayein.
b) Har tool ki misalein dein aur bataein ke yeh software development ko efficient aur accurate (sahi) kaise banate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key (Unit 1) MCQ 3, 6, 7 aur 9 ke liye c, b, c aur c deti hai. Chapter ka apna text b, c, a aur a ko support karta hai: framework structured bunyad deta hai (1.2.1), enhanced quality DevOps ka faida likha hai (DevOps), planning ka matlab kya, kaun aur kaise samajhna hai (1.4.1), aur contingency fund achanak masloon ke liye hai (1.4.3).
Short aur long sawalon ke jawab in lessons mein hain:

items: Short 1: Functional and Non-Functional Requirements. Short 2: 1.1.1.2 Testing. Short 3: Agile Methodology. Short 4: Other Methodologies (Scrum).
Short 5: 1.1.1 Risk Assessment and Management. Short 6: Use Case Diagrams. Short 7: Activity Diagrams. Short 8: 1.6.1.2 Factory Pattern.
Long 1: Design. Long 2: Agile Methodology. Long 3: Other Methodologies (Scrum).
Long 4: Use Case Diagrams. Long 5: Sequence Diagrams. Long 6: 1.8 Software Development Tools.
